import Order.Finset

open Finset

theorem lg_target {α : Type u_1} [LinearOrder α] [DenselyOrdered α] {s t : Finset α} (hs : s.Nonempty) (ht : t.Nonempty) (H : ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ y ∈ t, x < y) : ∃ b, (∀ x ∈ s, x < b) ∧ ∀ y ∈ t, b < y := by
  have : ∃ m, (∀ x ∈ s, x < m) ∧ ∀ y ∈ t, m < y :=
    Order.exists_between_finsets s t hs ht
  exact this
